changelog:
v1.10.7 Performance, Timezone & Games Update:
• Fixed scrolling stutter and lag on notes list by replacing regex stripping with single-pass snippet parsing and removing animateItem
• Instant note opening: immediate local SQLite lookup and native Compose markdown rendering for instant display without WebView blocking
• Fixed time-unaware note display with timezone-aware local time conversion (relative & full datetime)
• Added note creation date and last updated date display
• Added Games & Arcade feature: interactive Tic-Tac-Toe (AI & 2P), Connect Four, Snake, plus web room launcher with PIN join
